entities.name: gestate
entities.description: A programming language for sound and moving pictures, described in README.md; the project run as a manufacturing line under the method.

entities.name: doc/method.md
entities.description: A one-page tour explaining the method that runs the gestate project, written for someone shown the repository for the first time.

entities.name: README.md
entities.description: The document that explains what gestate is; you can hear it in about ten minutes.

entities.name: roadmap.md
entities.description: Lists the unbuilt parts of the project with reasons why they are not built.

entities.name: consent.md
entities.description: The register recording which named third parties agreed to being quoted in the tree, and what they declined.

entities.name: keeper.md
entities.description: Standard work for the one person who keeps the method documents, the month's evening work; 225 lines.

entities.name: vision.md
entities.description: The author's own, dated statement of what any of this is for; 77 lines.

entities.name: manifesto.md
entities.description: Describes how an instrument fails and the two standing rules; 377 lines.

entities.name: board/README.md
entities.description: Explains how a task is worked, written for sessions; 650 lines.

entities.name: spec/
entities.description: How each part of the project is designed, and what it cost; roughly 18,000 lines.

entities.name: fixme.md
entities.description: A register, not a backlog, of defects; 226 entries, 181 resolved, entries closed by being marked resolved rather than deleted.

entities.name: journal.md
entities.description: The current month's journal, recording what happened, past tense.

entities.name: journal/
entities.description: Archive holding one line per closed month, rotated from journal.md behind an index.

entities.name: doc/memory/
entities.description: One fact per file: what a session that forgets everything carries across between conversations.

entities.name: complaints.md
entities.description: Register of every error message the program can print, each with a verdict on whether a person who hit it could act on it.

entities.name: tools/seedaudit.py
entities.description: Audits any directory against the ten pieces required to be held to the method — present, gated, and every path the documents promise.

entities.name: .claude/settings.json
entities.description: Part of 'the fence', ensuring a session cannot edit its own restraints.

entities.name: tools/sandbox.sh
entities.description: Part of 'the fence', ensuring a session cannot edit its own restraints.

entities.name: test/test_safety.py
entities.description: The test that gates the fence (.claude/settings.json, tools/sandbox.sh).

entities.name: tools/suite.py
entities.description: Part of 'the gates', enforcing rules outside the model that must follow them.

entities.name: tools/pre-commit.sh
entities.description: Part of 'the gates', enforcing rules outside the model that must follow them.

entities.name: test/test_precommit.py
entities.description: The test that gates the gates (tools/suite.py, tools/pre-commit.sh).

entities.name: test/test_consent.py
entities.description: The test that gates the consent register, doc/consent.md.

entities.name: tools/andon.sh
entities.description: The andon: lets a session raise a question and reach a person who answers.

entities.name: test/test_andon.py
entities.description: The test that gates the andon, tools/andon.sh.

entities.name: test/test_board.py
entities.description: The test that gates a blocked status in board/README.md.

entities.name: spec/rules.md
entities.description: The rules cap document, keeping the rules short enough that a person actually reads them.

entities.name: tools/rulecount.py
entities.description: Tool enforcing the rules cap alongside spec/rules.md.

entities.name: test/test_rules.py
entities.description: The test that gates both the rules cap (spec/rules.md, tools/rulecount.py) and the boot surface (AGENTS.md).

entities.name: doc/memory/README.md
entities.description: The memory split: what is known about a person is not automatically the tree's.

entities.name: test/test_memory.py
entities.description: The test that gates the memory split, doc/memory/README.md.

entities.name: tools/limit.sh
entities.description: The sitting limit: the person's own hours are the person's.

entities.name: test/test_limit.py
entities.description: The test that gates the sitting limit, tools/limit.sh.

entities.name: AGENTS.md
entities.description: The boot surface: nothing else reaches a session unasked; also the index every session reads first.

entities.name: spec/author.md
entities.description: The author's own document, which no session rewrites.

entities.name: test/test_gemba.py
entities.description: The test that gates the author's own document, spec/author.md.

entities.name: ~/tend
entities.description: A second project started under this method, first audited by seedaudit on 2026-08-24, found to have six of the ten pieces present.

entities.name: the author
entities.description: The one person who has written the 413 commits and the method documents alongside a succession of AI sessions; wrote the corrections that condition the tree.

entities.name: the friend
entities.description: A person who had never seen the repository, asked to try installing gestate over chat, and found the cargo placeholder and duration defects.

entities.name: F162
entities.description: The ledger entry for the front-door instruction 'git clone <this-repo>' that assumed information only the author had, discovered when the friend asked what to put in the blank.

entities.name: the atlas
entities.description: A generated page in the tree, cited as an example of the same 'generator plus refusing hook' move used for the hooks index and the piece table.

entities.name: the hooks index
entities.description: The index every session reads first, found to have lost 19 of its 53 hooks because it lived outside the repository where nobody could track when.
